_comment: Single source of truth for Vanta hook registrations. Codex council P2 fix — drift between hooks/hooks.json + setup.sh + README was the failure mode. setup.sh now reads this file instead of hardcoding the registration table.
_schema: Each entry: { event, matcher (optional), file, runtime: 'node'|'bash', timeout (seconds), purpose }

registrations.purpose: Inject project brief into first response (4 lines)
Always-on: classify prompt + inject 3-line brief when relevant + on-cooldown

v3.6.14 shadow-mode rewriter — turns 1-line prompts into actionable engineer chains. Floor-matched + passthrough prompts inject nothing. Rule-matched prompts inject the suggested chain alongside the original.
Queue session for vanta-sync; episodic memory dedup by session_id
Constraint pack on auth/payment/migration writes + contradiction surface

Always-on: shape-only telemetry to interactions.jsonl, no inject no block. R5 P2 — registered BEFORE git-guardrails so blocked Bash commands still get telemetry. R10 P1 — `prepend: true` puts it at FRONT of settings.json so other plugins' blocking hooks can't shadow telemetry.
Hard-block + advisory on destructive git/sql/rm commands
Shadow Council flag on sensitive plan content
Incremental refresh of per-project knowledge shards
Always-on: post-side telemetry — captures success/fail bit. R10 P1 — `prepend: true` so other plugins' PostToolUse hooks can't shadow telemetry.
